SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USERS WHERE SIGNUP_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)

SELECT TO_CHAR(d.dt, 'MM/DD') AS label, NVL(c.cnt, 0) AS cnt FROM ( SELECT TRUNC(SYSDATE) - LEVEL + 1 AS dt FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 7 ) d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT TRUNC(SIGNUP_DATE) AS dt, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM USERS GROUP BY TRUNC(SIGNUP_DATE) ) c ON c.dt = d.dt ORDER BY d.dt DESC

SELECT TO_CHAR(d.mth, 'MM"월"') AS label, NVL(c.cnt, 0) AS cnt FROM ( SELECT ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -LEVEL + 1) AS mth FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 6 ) d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT TRUNC(SIGNUP_DATE, 'MM') AS mth, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM USERS GROUP BY TRUNC(SIGNUP_DATE, 'MM') ) c ON c.mth = d.mth ORDER BY d.mth DESC

SELECT l.LOG_NO AS logNo, l.DESCRIPTION AS description, l.LOGIN_IP AS loginIp, l.CONNECTION_STATUS AS status, u.USER_NAME AS userName, c.COMPANY_NAME AS companyName, l.INPUT_DATE AS inputDate FROM LOGINLOG l LEFT JOIN USERS u ON l.USER_NO = u.USER_NO LEFT JOIN COMPANY c ON u.COMPANY_NO = c.COMPANY_NO ORDER BY l.INPUT_DATE DESC FETCH FIRST 50 ROWS ONLY
